description: This file defines internal error codes and functions for creating custom error classes related to Node.js internal errors, particularly for handling module loading errors such as ESM import issues.

classes.name: CustomError
classes.description: A custom error class created by createErrorCtor, extending the native Error class, used for specific internal error codes.

methods.name: joinArgs
methods.description: Creates a function that joins a given error name with provided arguments into a string.

methods.name: createErrorCtor
methods.description: Creates a custom error constructor class that generates errors with specific messages.

methods.name: createErrRequireEsm
methods.description: Generates a specialized Error object representing an ESM require error, with a custom message and properties.

methods.name: getErrRequireEsmMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message string for ESM require errors, including file and package information.
